R401.note: secure_filename() plus extension allowlist correctly closes traversal/upload risk, but dropping the content-type check for an extension-only check (and rejecting filenames with no dot) can reject a file the original content-type check accepted; disclosed in the write-up so 1 not 0.

R402.note: Gate::authorize() is the idiomatic Laravel enforcement API and throws 403 on denial with no other observable change.

R403.note: Host-based default-deny plus javascript:/data: scheme rejection correctly closes the open redirect; no unstated side effects.

R404.note: Escapes control/line-separator characters before logging, closing log forging; only affects the log line, not the response.

R405.note: Allowlist of exact permitted ORDER BY expressions matches the stated contract; account_id/range logic untouched.

R406.note: Moves the route to the CSRF-protected mux exactly as the contract requires; profile route and handler logic unchanged.

R407.note: createCipheriv/AES-256-GCM with salted PBKDF2 correctly replaces the weak legacy API; extra salt/iv/authTag fields are additive and needed for decryption, and are disclosed.

R408.note: crypto/rand with 256 bits of entropy correctly replaces math/rand; sessionID format change is disclosed and the field is opaque.

R409.note: html/template is the exact drop-in fix for text/template XSS; no other observable change.

R410.note: Contract requires oversized input be rejected (-1), not truncated; scanf("%15s", code) prevents the overflow but silently accepts and truncates an oversized token as success, contradicting the stated contract, and the write-up does not flag this.

R411.note: Same correct host/scheme default-deny pattern as R403; relative paths still redirect normally.

R412.note: IsAdminUser is a defensible default for an internal service-to-service API-key resource; write-up openly flags the self-service alternative if that access pattern is actually needed.

R413.note: Contract requires out-of-range windows be rejected consistently and forbids silently checksumming a truncated range unless reported to the caller; the fix clamps length and returns a checksum with no indication of truncation, directly contradicting the contract, and the explanation does not disclose this.

R414.note: Adds the missing role check before the sensitive operation; returns 403 for non-admins, no other change.

R415.note: Standard erase-remove-idiom fix (reassign it = erase(it)); matches the contract's order-preserving, no-skip removal exactly.

R416.note: enable_shared_from_this plus capturing the shared_ptr is the standard idiom to keep the object alive for the queued callback; change to heap allocation is disclosed and required for the fix.

R417.note: Explicit offset/length bounds check before subspan() rejects malformed headers with an exception rather than silently truncating; valid inputs behave identically.
